_comment: Strand B owns this file; strand D's layout validator reads zone_requirements, capability_hazards, min_walkway_width_m, min_egress_width_m and human_robot_separation_m. Other keys are sourced rules for the validator to adopt. Distances in metres. Sources and confidence in _sources.

robot_arm_non_collaborative.separation_formula: S = K*T + C (ISO 13855): K = 2.0 m/s (hand/arm) or 1.6 m/s if S > 0.5 m; C = 8*(d-14) mm for a light curtain of resolution d mm

flammable_liquids_nfpa45_gal._unit: US gallons; per 100 ft2 / per lab unit; class B (moderate) labs, Class I liquids
flammable_liquids_nfpa45_gal.storage: listed safety cans or flammable storage cabinets
flammable_liquids_nfpa45_gal.cabinet: one per lab, remote from exits, not under fume hoods, not in corridors, not vented

min_walkway_width_m.note: Kept between the NIH absolute minimum (0.92 m) and the recommended working aisle (1.525 m); changing it would change every layout's violations, so a validator owner decision.

recommended_aisle_width_m.quote: Laboratory module widths are normally determined by an appropriate aisle width of 1 525 mm plus bench or equipment space equal to 914 mm on each side of this aisle.

absolute_min_aisle_width_m.quote: A minimum 0.92 m clear aisle space shall be maintained around laboratory benches and furniture.

min_egress_width_m.note: Stricter than codes: OSHA exit access >= 0.711 m, ADA walking surface 0.914 m, Stanford: 'A pathway clearance of 36 inches must be maintained at the face of access/exit doors.'

code_min_exit_access_width_m.quote: An exit access must be at least 28 inches (71.1 cm) wide at all points.

min_door_clear_width_m.note: IBC 1010.1.1 32 in (813 mm) minimum clear width, from a code summary; ADA 404.2.3 also 32 in.

fume_hood.quote: For new installations, laboratory hoods shall not be located adjacent to a single means of access to an exit or to high-traffic areas. (NFPA 45 6.9.2, via TSI LC-125); 3.05 m from doors is Stanford's recommendation ('more than 10 feet from any door or doorway').

biosafety_cabinet.note: Distances from University of Michigan EHS table citing NIH BSC placement requirements; BMBL 6th ed.: place BSCs remote from entry and away from fume hoods, supply registers, centrifuges and vacuum pumps.

cryogen_area.quote: Oxygen deficiency monitor units must provide an oxygen readout and a local audible and visible alarm when the oxygen level falls below 19.5 percent.

hazard_clearance_m.high_g.quote: Maintain a 30-cm (1-ft) clearance area around the centrifuge while it is running.

human_robot_separation_m.note: No standard gives a fixed distance; ISO 13855 computes it from stopping time (see robot_arm_non_collaborative). OSHA requires guards or presence sensing around the envelope.

flammable_liquids_nfpa45_gal.note: NFPA 45 table as republished by AIChE CEP (Jul 2017); check the current NFPA 45 edition before citing as code. Cabinet rules: NIH DRM D.10.8.
